name: apple-ui-craft
description: Principal-engineer-grade Apple UI craft for iOS 26. Seven agents, pinned to Opus 5 at dispatch (the session model conducts), that design, review, optimize, and craft SwiftUI so it feels like Apple built it -- Liquid Glass, spring animation, intentional haptics, accessibility from birth, SwiftUI performance, and deep platform + cross-platform integration (widgets, Live Activities, App Intents, Apple Intelligence, WebView, watchOS/tvOS/visionOS/CarPlay). Since 0.3.0 the review also covers the dimensions no single screenshot can show -- task flow, information architecture, error recovery, adaptive layout under Dynamic Type and window size -- plus window economy, and it returns NOT ASSESSED rather than a false clean verdict when the evidence cannot reach them; the reviewers reach the Runtime evidence mode through XcodeBuildMCP (build, run, snapshot_ui geometry) when it is available. Six skills: design-ios (greenfield screen/flow creation, now flow-mapped and adaptive-contracted), review-ios-ui (HIG + visual + interaction + usability audit), optimize-ios-ui (animation + haptics + performance tuning), craft-ios-ui (full 5-specialist team sweep), audit-accessibility (deep a11y audit), integrate-platform (system-integration audit). Backed by a self-contained reference library of 93 files across 13 content domains (see ARCHITECTURE.md) distilled from an 88-document iOS vault (~103,000 lines), a Context7-verified version-floor registry, a labelled SwiftUI regression corpus with a zero-dependency scorer, GoodMem learnings, and serena navigation. Under ultracode the session model conducts, and conductor-selected executors (Opus 5 @ xhigh for every dispatched agent, Sonnet 5 @ xhigh for non-coding grunt) run the scoped grunt stages. Read-only review by default; findings apply only on explicit user approval.
